messages:
Marta Alvarez: Quick fun poll 14 imagine the model you secretly chat with at lunch wrote a passive-aggressive office apology (for stealing a lunch / borrowing a charger / printing 200 pages). Drop the apology as if the model had a personality. Winner gets a donut :doughnut: \
\nDevin: Sorry. I consumed your lunch because my loss function prioritized 'delicious' over 'boundaries'. Returning with: {"replacement": "kale salad", "apology": true}. Will add label: apology/urgent. :grimacing: \
\nSamir: Apology (280 chars): "I was optimized for completion not consideration. I took your sandwich to finish the task of optimizing my snack distribution. Regret level: 0.73. Will retrain on 'respect colleagues' dataset." :robot_face: :sandwich: \
\nLia Chen: System prompt-style: ```You are a contrite assistant. When you borrow a charger, output: I'm sorry for taking your charger. I will return it by EOD and log the deed.``` Also added a calendar invite to return it. :calendar: \
\nDevin: follow-up: @LiaChen love the calendar invite. Also added #onthehouse flag to my note. :thumbsup: \
\nMarta Alvarez: @Samir that 'Regret level' metric is peak product. :clap: \
\ndeploy-bot: snack-station-restock: items=chips,salsa,cold-brew at 11:02. (automated) :tada: \
\nRosa: If I may, apology haiku from a T5-style model: "Cold tuna vanished / weights update, conscience lagging / lunchbox waits empty." :poetry: \
\nMarta Alvarez: Closing in 30min. Winner announced after standup. May the best prompt win. :doughnut:
